{{Quote|For an illuminating example of pan-species cooperation, don't miss the moon of Alchenaut, where palm-sized furballs that I named o'cerrys act as a predator warning system for thousands of other herbivores.|An excerpt from ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'', by Jedi Biologist Bowspritz|<ref name="TJP" />}}
'''Alchenaut''' was a terrestrial [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="TJP" /> that was located in the [[Alchenaut system/Legends|Alchenaut system]] of the [[Alchenaut sector/Legends|Alchenaut sector]], within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="Atlas Appendix" /> portion of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]].<ref name="Western Reaches" /> The moon had a rich ecosystem that provided a [[Homeworld/Legends|habitat]] for numerous [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] [[Species/Legends|species]], as well as at least one predator. Among the former were the [[o'cerry]]s, which cooperated with thousands of other herbivores by warning them whenever a predator approached.<ref name="TJP" />

At some point by [[990 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/12/endnotes-for-star-wars-jedi-path-part-1.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Jedi Path (part 1 of 4)|quote=Okay, so we've established that this particular copy of the book dates from 115 BBY. But the content inside is [...] dating from the year 990 BBY.}}</ref> Alchenaut was visited by the [[Jedi Biologist]] [[Bowspritz]], who studied the moon's animal life and named the o'cerrys in the process. Viewing them as an enlightening occurrence of collaboration between species, Bowspritz included the o'cerrys, along with a mention of Alchenaut, in the "Galactic Bestiary" section of the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alchenaut was created for the [[2010]] reference book [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']] by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TJP" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Alchenaut [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the moon Alchenaut, in grid square L-16.<ref name="Atlas Appendix" />
